description: Source code for mkbrnimg utility, which creates firmware images with CRC and footer metadata, based on OpenWrt's wndr3700.c.

methods.name: init_crc32
methods.description: Initializes the crc32 lookup table based on the polynomial.

methods.name: crc32buf
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for a buffer.

methods.name: parseopts
methods.description: Parses command-line options for output file, magic number, signature, and CRC32 polynomial.

methods.name: appendfile
methods.description: Appends a file to the output firmware image, computes CRC, adds padding and footer.
